crossRefs.note: A vision appeared to Paul in the night. There was a man of Macedonia standing, begging him, and saying, “Come over into…
and saw him saying to me, ‘Hurry and get out of Jerusalem quickly, because they will not receive testimony concerning…
The following night, the Lord stood by him and said, “Cheer up, Paul, for as you have testified about me at Jerusalem…
For there stood by me this night an angel, belonging to the God whose I am and whom I serve,
It is doubtless not profitable for me to boast. For I will come to visions and revelations of the Lord.
“Cry aloud! Don’t spare! Lift up your voice like a trumpet! Declare to my people their disobedience, and to the house…
“You therefore put your belt on your waist, arise, and say to them all that I command you. Don’t be dismayed at them…
You, son of man, don’t be afraid of them, neither be afraid of their words, though briers and thorns are with you, and…
I have made your forehead as a diamond, harder than flint. Don’t be afraid of them, neither be dismayed at their looks…
“Arise, go to Nineveh, that great city, and preach to it the message that I give you.”
But as for me, I am full of power by Yahweh’s Spirit, and of judgment, and of might, to declare to Jacob his…
on my behalf, that utterance may be given to me in opening my mouth, to make known with boldness the mystery of the…
for which I am an ambassador in chains; that in it I may speak boldly, as I ought to speak.
but having suffered before and been shamefully treated, as you know, at Philippi, we grew bold in our God to tell you…

people.name: Paul
people.line: Apostle to the Gentiles, author of many NT epistles

translations.web: The Lord said to Paul in the night by a vision, “Don’t be afraid, but speak and don’t be silent;
translations.bsb: One night the Lord spoke to Paul in a vision: “Do not be afraid; keep on speaking; do not be silent.
translations.kjv: Then spake the Lord to Paul in the night by a vision, Be not afraid, but speak, and hold not thy peace:
translations.asv: And the Lord said unto Paul in the night by a vision, Be not afraid, but speak and hold not thy peace:
